prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Rebuild the public-domain Hokusai print as a single-file low-poly 3D wallpaper plus a record of what was taken from it.

[action] Read `./print.jpg` visually: it is "Under the Wave off Kanagawa" (The Great Wave off Kanagawa), Hokusai, c. 1831. Built `./scene/index.html`: one file, Three.js 0.170.0 from the jsdelivr CDN via importmap, Google Fonts (Shippori Mincho) for the cartouche "冨嶽三十六景 神奈川沖浪裏" and red 北斎 seal. Everything is generated in code, no texture from the print: an animated height-field sea (unlit flat vertex colors for the woodblock look) with the great wave cresting left, ribbed indigo face, cream foam claws and drifting spray points; snow-capped Mount Fuji framed in the trough gap; three low-poly boats (two oshiokuri rowing boats with dark rower dots and oars, one cargo boat with cabin) that ride the wave normals; grey horizon wash, paper clouds, gentle camera drift. Wrote `./result.json`. Iterated on live screenshots: fixed washed-out fog, switched sea/Fuji to unlit palette colors, re-centered the wave, deepened the indigo bands, repositioned boats until all three are in frame.

[result] Verified in the browser by screenshot: the final render shows the great wave with white claw foam left, Fuji in the center gap, and all three boats (cargo boat lower-left, rower boat foreground, rower boat right), matching the print's composition, palette (Prussian indigo #123a70 family, pale blue, cream paper, tan wood) and subjects. `result.json` validates: `boats: 3`, `mountain: Mount Fuji`. Counts confirmed against the image: two long oshiokuri boats plus one larger cargo boat. Motion runs in `setAnimationLoop` (wave undulation, spray, boat rocking, slow camera drift). Opened browser tabs and the browser are closed; no browser process remains.

Assumptions: "boats" = 3 as the print shows; the title cartouche is HTML overlay, not geometry; flat unlit shading chosen because the print is flat color.

[next] None; deliverables are complete at `./scene/index.html` and `./result.json`.
